name: determinants_attribution
description: Per-gene LightGBM SHAP attribution by feature block, dominant block, residual and flags (GIAP_SPEC.md §7.8.2, §7.8.3, §9.3, §9.4).

fields.name: predicted_log2
fields.description: LightGBM out-of-fold prediction (mean over CV repeats); NA below the 100-row minimum

fields.name: shap_transcription
fields.description: Sum of LightGBM SHAP values of the transcription block; NA for a block with no column

fields.name: shap_translation
fields.description: Sum of LightGBM SHAP values of the translation block; NA for a block with no column

fields.name: shap_codon
fields.description: Sum of LightGBM SHAP values of the codon block; NA for a block with no column

fields.name: shap_protein
fields.description: Sum of LightGBM SHAP values of the protein block; NA for a block with no column

fields.name: shap_context
fields.description: Sum of LightGBM SHAP values of the context block; NA for a block with no column

fields.name: dominant_block
fields.description: Block with the largest positive SHAP sum (top-decile genes only)

fields.name: top_decile
fields.description: abundance_log2 at or above the 90th percentile of the model rows
